description: This Python source file provides utility functions to manage environment variables and create a cached Supabase client using the supabase SDK. It includes functions for reading environment variables, handling required variables, picking appropriate API keys for server-side access, and exposing a singleton client instance and schema name.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Supabase client class used to interact with the Supabase backend.

methods.name: str _env(name: str)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable with safe stripping of whitespace.

methods.name: str _required_env(name: str)
methods.description: Reads a required environment variable or raises an error if not set.

methods.name: str _pick_supabase_key()
methods.description: Selects the appropriate Supabase API key for server-side access, prioritizing service role key over anonymous key.

methods.name: Client get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Returns a cached Supabase client, creating it on first call based on environment variables.

methods.name: str get_supabase_schema()
methods.description: Returns the Supabase schema name, defaulting to 'public' if not specified.
